title: Static Low-Ovoid Long-Curved-Bill Kiwi
description: One newly authored complete stylised kiwi-like bird in a fixed two-foot pose. A low forward-sloping ovoid body continuously narrows into a short small head without a distinct long upright neck, external wing panels or projecting tail plume. A very long thin gently downcurved bill extends from that head; two tiny lateral eyes, two stout short bent legs and two complete thick forward-cleft toe feet finish the silhouette. All body stations, bill curve and feet are new. Not an owl with its facial discs removed or a scaled ostrich with shortened neck: torso/head proportion, slender long bill, close low belly and robust short-legged support are built together, no old visible meshes imported. One model zero scenes. No feather-strand simulation, exact species, anatomical toe diagnosis, feeding, gait, rig, animation, care or handling-safety claim.
